def solve_C():
    import sys
    input = sys.stdin.read
    data = input().split()
    
    n = int(data[0])
    a = list(map(int, data[1:]))
    
    sequence = []
    
    for A_i in a:
        size = 2 ** A_i
        sequence.append(size)
        
        while len(sequence) > 1 and sequence[-1] == sequence[-2]:
            last = sequence.pop()
            sequence.pop()
            sequence.append(last * 2)
    
    print(len(sequence))
